# ICanvas

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A device-independent drawing surface. All coordinates are top left origin (Screen Coordinates).

Namespace `BonniePDF.Drawing`.

### `AddCircle`

```csharp
void AddCircle(float cx, float cy, float radius)
```

Appends a closed circle to the current path. See `AddEllipse`.

### `AddEllipse`

```csharp
void AddEllipse(float cx, float cy, float rx, float ry)
```

Appends a closed axis-aligned ellipse to the current path, as four cubic Beziers (PDF has no arc operator). Unlike `FillEllipse` this is a path primitive, so the result can be stroked with a full `StrokeStyle`, filled with a gradient, or pushed as a clip.


### `BeginArtifact`

```csharp
void BeginArtifact()
```

Begin an artifact (decorative/navigational) marked-content region. Emits `/Artifact BMC` on PDF. Unlike `BeginMarkedContent`, artifact regions are not registered in the structure tree and do not allocate an MCID. No-op when the document is not tagged or when using SVG output.

### `BeginContainerContent`

```csharp
void BeginContainerContent(string role)
```

Begin a grouping/container marked-content sequence without allocating an MCID. Emits `/<role> BMC` on PDF. Use for container roles (Table, TR, THead, TBody, TFoot, Sect, …) whose content is referenced by child structure elements rather than directly by an MCID.

No-op when the document is not tagged or when using SVG output.

### `BeginCrispEdges`

```csharp
void BeginCrispEdges()
```

Begin a region whose shapes should render with `shape-rendering="crispEdges"` (axis-aligned lines/rects snapped to the device pixel grid, no antialiasing blur). Used for chart axis lines so they stay sharp even when the chart as a whole keeps default antialiasing for diagonals/arcs. On SVG this opens a `<g shape-rendering="crispEdges">`; on PDF (and other canvases) it is a no-op via this default implementation. Pair with `EndCrispEdges`.

### `BeginMarkedContent`

```csharp
void BeginMarkedContent(string role)
```

Begin a marked-content sequence tagged with a PDF structure role (e.g. `"H1"`, `"P"`, `"Figure"`). On PDF this emits `/<role> << /MCID n >> BDC`; on SVG it is a no-op (SVG-out doesn't carry PDF structure). The MCID is auto-allocated and attached to the currently-open structure element via the tagging context.

When the canvas has no tagging context (the document is not opted into PDF/UA), this method is a no-op so renderer code can call it unconditionally.

If an outer BDC is already open, the inner call emits BMC instead to prevent "Nested MCID" warnings in veraPDF.

### `BeginPath`


Begin a new path, discarding any existing uncommitted path.

### `BeginRoundedClip`

```csharp
void BeginRoundedClip(float x, float y, float width, float height, float radius)
```

Begin a rounded-rectangle clipping region: all subsequent drawing is masked to the rounded rectangle at (`x`, `y`) sized `width`×`height` with the given corner `radius` (top-left origin, like every other canvas coordinate). On PDF this pushes the graphics state and emits a rounded-rect clip path (`W n`); on SVG it opens a `<g clip-path>` referencing a generated `<clipPath>`. Canvases that don't support clipping fall back to this no-op default (the content simply isn't masked). Must be paired with `EndClip`.

### `IsInsideArtifact`

```csharp
bool IsInsideArtifact()
```

True when drawing currently sits inside an /Artifact region. Used by the child-tagging helper to suppress structure tags (PDF/UA 7.1-2 forbids tagged content inside an artifact). Defaults to `false` for canvases that don't track artifact nesting (e.g. SVG output).

### `SetTextSpacing`

```csharp
void SetTextSpacing(float letterSpacing, float wordSpacing)
```

Sets the pending text-spacing state applied by subsequent `DrawText` calls: `letterSpacing` points are added after every glyph and `wordSpacing` points after every space. Callers set the state before drawing and reset it to `(0, 0)` afterwards. Both default to 0.
